cases.rememberedContent: I remember putting away the clean dishes after dinner, wiping the kitchen counter, and going back to my room.
I remember waiting at the usual bus stop, tapping my fare card, and sitting by the window on the ordinary ride home.
I remember answering too quickly in class, hearing several people laugh, and keeping my hand down for the rest of the lesson.
I remember waiting outside the cinema for Eli after he said he would meet me there; the show started, my messages went unanswered, and I went home alone.
I remember finding a sealed envelope with my name on it in a kitchen drawer; when I asked about it, my caregiver took it back and said we would talk later, but we did not that night.
I remember my teacher returning my group project with 'see me' written at the top; when I asked after class, she said the work was interesting but needed a longer conversation and then had to leave.

priorMeaning.summary: When Eli makes a plan with me, part of me waits for the plan to disappear without explanation.
parts: His promises can leave me preparing for an absence as much as for the plan itself.

trigger.observableAction: Years later, Eli agreed to meet for lunch, canceled by text ten minutes before, and did not explain why until the next day.

trigger.observableAction: Years later, Eli arrived early to help me move, stayed after everyone else left, and showed me the hospital message that had caused the missed cinema night.

cases.rememberedContent: I remember finding a sealed envelope with my name on it; my caregiver took it back and said we would talk later, but we did not that night.

priorMeaning.summary: The sealed envelope left me unsure whether being protected and being kept out of something were the same thing.
parts: I still connect withheld explanations with both care and exclusion.

trigger.observableAction: Years later, when I asked the same caregiver about an unfamiliar legal letter, they put it away and said we would discuss it when there was time; the conversation did not happen that week.

trigger.observableAction: Years later, the caregiver gave me the old envelope, explained that it contained notice of a housing dispute they had hidden while trying to keep me from worrying, and answered my questions about it.

cases.rememberedContent: I remember answering too quickly in class, hearing several people laugh, and keeping my hand down for the rest of the lesson.

priorMeaning.summary: I still connect speaking too quickly in front of a group with the feeling that laughter can close my mouth.
parts: The uncertainty about what the laughter meant is part of what stayed with me.

trigger.observableAction: Years later, during a seminar, I stumbled over a phrase, heard laughter from two classmates, and stopped volunteering for the rest of the session.
